integrity: Exact proofs and standalone reproducibility programs included; finite tests corroborate and cannot certify the infinite theorem. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No basin or transient-entry-time distribution. Classical 1988 no-singleton/no-triple cyclic Lucas enumerations and the double-cover method are prior ingredients; only the cubic graph census and twist sign law are assessed as new. An unindexed earlier equivalent remains a priority risk; full 1980 Goles–Olivos source was not accessible.
title: A modulo-six twist resonance in synchronous majority dynamics on cubic cyclic ladders
